description: Item 13 / Direction D-1 (Monitoring). Scheduled scorer re-run of ca_notice_scorer.py against the v0.2 dev split (12 items, non-held-out) only. Self-throttles on a daytime/evening window (09:00-23:00 PT) and a 3-day cadence -- safe to leave in queue/ for repeated dispatcher drain cycles; it will self-defer (no scoring, no writes) outside those bounds rather than relying on precise external cron timing. Held-out split is never scored, loaded, or referenced. Rules remain read-only (frozen as vProof1) -- this job only appends to VALIDATION_METRICS_LEDGER.md and DAILY_CHANGELOG.md (regression alarm only, when newly_failing > 0).
live_verification_needed: RESOLVED 2026-07-16: Andy ran `python3 rules/validation/scorer/dev_set_monitor.py --force` from Terminal with real keys (dev 12/12, newly_failing=0) and set live_verified=true. NOTE (2026-07-18): `recurring: true` added after discovering the dispatcher's finalize_job() would otherwise unlink() this file from queue/ on its very first pickup -- even a self-deferred exit 0 counted as 'done' -- permanently breaking the 3-day cadence after one dispatcher cycle. See dispatch.py finalize_job() docstring.
trigger_hook: rules/validation/scorer/dev_set_monitor.py exposes arm_trigger(reason) -- call it immediately after any ratified rule change to force the next drain cycle to run regardless of the 3-day cadence (still subject to the daytime-window guard). Not wired to an automatic call site yet because no rule change is possible until v0.3 scoring completes; the mechanism is live and ready per the directive's 'wire the trigger now' instruction.
